Body.Content:
Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration for User Data Migration (UDM) and Shared Data Migration (SDM) allows customers to move their Microsoft 365 data from one Microsoft tenant to another. UDM includes the ability to move user mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, Teams chats, and Teams meetings. SDM includes the ability to move M365 Groups, SharePoint Sites, Group Mailboxes, and teams and channels.

More info: TBD

GA date: December CY2026
